name: Scooping Kick (Combat, Technique)
body:
With phenomenal force and a perfect angle, you boot a prone target into the air for a moment.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Trip, Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +4

Benefit(s): When you successfully hit a prone opponent with an unarmed strike, you may launch them 5 feet into the air for a few seconds. This nullifies their AC bonus against ranged attacks until the start of their next turn. While airborne in this way, any creature (including you) may still gain the +4 bonus on a melee attack made to strike a prone opponent. If the target is hit by a melee attack gaining this bonus or begins its turn, it is knocked back to the ground. A character with this feat may benefit from attacking a prone target and keep the target aloft. A creature knocked into the air in this way takes a -5 penalty to its CMD against bull rush and overrun maneuvers until it is knocked to the ground or its turn begins.
